query: INSERT INTO thread_participants(reader_key,root_id,role,note,joined_at_activity,last_seen_activity,closed_at_activity,closed_reason,replaced_by) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,NULL,NULL,NULL) ON CONFLICT(reader_key,root_id) DO UPDATE SET role=excluded.role, note=COALESCE(excluded.note,thread_participants.note), joined_at_activity=excluded.joined_at_activity,last_seen_activity=excluded.last_seen_activity, closed_at_activity=NULL,closed_reason=NULL,replaced_by=NULL
